review_findings_resolved.finding: Retained old results could be re-expanded while a new GPS/request was pending.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Expansion resets in each real query handler; toggle disabled while loading or GPS requesting. Deferred GPS plus deferred pharmacy response case passes, including re-expansion attempts and final four-row result.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Opening/closing the area picker is not itself a new query.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Expansion and request count remain stable when picker is opened then closed without submission; tested.

review_findings_resolved.finding: The browser fixture treated the existing offscreen ShareCard QR image as unexpected traffic.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Only the precise HTTPS QR origin/path with resourceType image is fulfilled locally using a synthetic SVG; all other unexpected traffic still aborts and fails the assertion. Reviewed statically; no browser execution claimed.

semantic_review: Initial view retains first three records in source order; expansion/collapse derives a view without discarding records or refetching.
GPS refresh and submitted manual query both reset expansion. Unrelated elder-mode preference and unsubmitted picker changes preserve it.
Expanded control exposes aria-expanded and a reversible collapse label; no expansion control for zero through three results.
GPS banner adjusts between first-three and all-results wording; card animation delay is capped at 0.2 seconds rather than growing with total rows.
Map keeps its existing explicitly labeled three-marker contract. Provider hooks, data policy, pharmacy provenance and share behavior are unchanged.

Browser test uses real onboarding/manual picker/page/cards, five local fixtures and a second submitted district; it checks expansion, collapse, preference preservation and reset without live provider/QR calls.
limits: This reviewer independently ran only the focused 11-case jsdom suite. Root-owned full npm, type, build, and hosted CI receipts remain separate.
The Playwright spec was source-reviewed; no local browser installation or execution occurred. Hosted browser validation remains necessary.
JSDOM tests do not prove visual layout, real image capture, native sharing, live provider freshness or offline PWA behavior.
No candidate source edits or remote writes were made by this reviewer.
